descriptions.job-1nb3n3m:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Web Presence and Platform (WPP) designs, builds, and operates Stripe’s public web presence, including stripe.com and other sites that may be the first impression of Stripe for many. We create industry-leading experiences that help customers understand the power of Stripe’s platform, share Stripe’s ideas and expertise, and drive adoption. We also build the systems and operational foundations behind those experiences, making our websites fast, stable, and easy to evolve.

Our work brings together design craft, engineering, operations, and business strategy. We want to make every pixel count, create experiences that are both useful and compelling, and help other Stripes benefit from the systems and capabilities we build.

What you’ll do

WPP’s Design Systems pod builds and stewards Helm, the shared design system behind stripe.com. We create the components, patterns, tools, and guidance that help WPP teams deliver expressive, consistent, and high-quality web experiences at scale. We work across design and engineering to keep design intent, production code, and real-world usage aligned as the system evolves.

As an engineer on the Design Systems pod, you will turn Stripe’s visual direction into reusable, production-ready capabilities. You’ll shape components from early design through implementation, testing, documentation, adoption, and ongoing iteration. You’ll combine strong design judgment with frontend expertise to ensure Helm works across responsive layouts, interaction states, accessibility needs, performance constraints, content models, and locales. You’ll also partner with teams building on Helm, helping them use the system effectively, identify reusable patterns, and contribute improvements back to it.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build polished, accessible, and performant React components and patterns that express Stripe’s visual language across stripe.com
  • Partner closely with designers and engineers to shape component behavior, APIs, responsive states, interaction details, and design-token architecture
  • Maintain a high bar for design–code parity and component quality through documentation, accessibility and visual-regression testing, production validation, and in-context review
  • Help workstream teams decide when to compose existing capabilities, extend the system, or keep an implementation local, and lead the upstreaming of broadly reusable work
  • Improve how designers, engineers, content authors, and agents discover, understand, and adopt Helm through clear guidance, examples, tooling, and responsive collaboration

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant frontend or design engineering experience building production web experiences or the shared systems and tooling behind them
  • Experience building and maintaining a production design system or shared component library, including evolving it through real-world use
  • Proficiency with React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with experience taking interactive, responsive work from design through production
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools as a regular part of software engineering work, with sound judgment about validating their output and maintaining code, product, and security quality
  • Experience designing flexible component APIs, primitives, tokens, and composition models that give skilled practitioners meaningful control while preserving accessibility and maintainability
  • Strong visual and interaction-design judgment, along with the communication skills to collaborate with experienced designers and engineers on ambiguous system-level tradeoffs

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building expressive, brand-forward web experiences where consistency must coexist with differentiated art direction
  • Familiarity with CMS-driven experiences, structured content, localization, or other constraints involved in supporting a large global website
  • Experience with tools and practices that connect design and code, such as Figma libraries, design tokens, Code Connect, component documentation, or visual-regression testing
  • Experience migrating consumers between design systems or evolving shared components while maintaining compatibility across existing production surfaces

About Coinflow

Coinflow is the next-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud & chargeback indemnity, global pay-ins, multi-currency FX, and unified payouts. Founded in 2023, the company serves marketplaces, fintechs, remittance providers, gaming platforms, and ecommerce merchants worldwide.

Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi-billion-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments.

Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at coinflow.cash.

Role Overview

Coinflow is seeking a Product Operations & Strategy Associate to keep our product machine running. Coinflow moves money for merchants around the world, and every bank, processor and enterprise partner wants to understand exactly how we work before they sign. As our Product Operations & Strategy Associate, you'll own those due diligence requests end to end, keep our Linear board an accurate picture of what's being built, and be the connective tissue between Product and every team that depends on it. You'll report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Risk & Compliance, Legal, Finance, Sales and Partnerships.

This is an operations role, and we mean that: most of your week is moving information between people, chasing answers, keeping records clean and running projects to done. It's a great fit for someone early in their career who gets real satisfaction from turning chaos into a reliable system, and who wants to learn how a modern payments company works from the inside.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner and vendor due diligence: Own intake-to-submission for due diligence questionnaires, RFIs and information requests from banks, processors, vendors and enterprise merchants. Answer the recurring questions yourself (company overview, products and money flows, ownership and UBOs, licenses, policies, security posture), route the rest to the right owner, and hit every deadline
  • Answer library and records: Maintain our due diligence answer library and document repository (corporate docs, org chart, policies, audit and security reports) so every answer is current, accurate and reusable
  • Linear and delivery hygiene: Run a weekly sweep of the Linear board so owners, statuses, priorities and due dates are set and stale or blocked work is flagged; triage incoming requests from other teams with enough context to act on
  • Cross-team communication: Keep Sales, Support, Risk and Partnerships informed on what's shipping and changing; coordinate launch checklists, capture decisions and drive follow-ups from product meetings; run small cross-functional projects end to end
  • Research and reporting: Prepare roadmap snapshots, release notes and status summaries for leadership; run competitive, market and vendor research and turn messy inputs into clear memos

Required Qualifications

  • 1-3 years in operations, onboarding or implementation, compliance operations, project coordination, or Big 4 audit/advisory, ideally at a fintech, payments company or bank
  • Excellent written communication; able to answer a partners question accurately in two clean sentences
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort keeping many requests moving at once
  • High ownership: you finish what you start and close loops without being chased
  • Comfortable working across many teams and following up persistently and politely
  • Fluency with work tools (Linear or Jira, Slack, Google Workspace, Notion) and a habit of using AI tools to speed up repetitive work
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and the pace of a high-growth startup, and ready to work hard

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or financial services
  • Familiarity with cards, ACH, other payment rails, or KYB/KYC/AML concepts
  • Experience completing vendor, security, or bank due diligence questionnaires
  • Experience being part of world class operations and high functioning product organizations.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation including base salary, performance bonus, and meaningful ownership
  • Broad exposure across product, compliance, partnerships, and engineering at a rapidly scaling fintech
  • Direct work with the Head of Product and visibility into how leadership decides what to build
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment with world-class investors

The base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $120,000 USD + equity. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications, and business needs.

Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross-border payments market.

Product Marketing turns Chainalysis innovation into customer value. We position our intelligence as solutions customers can understand and consume through our platform, shape how we commercialize them, and give GTM the stories and strategic assets to win.

The public sector is a priority growth segment for Chainalysis, spanning law enforcement, intelligence agencies, regulators and tax authorities. As digital assets become more integrated into the financial system, these organizations need the intelligence, tools and tradecraft to advance their missions—from shaping policy and enforcing the rules to disrupting illicit networks and protecting national security. This role connects Chainalysis capabilities to those mission priorities, with a clear, compelling story for agency leaders and operational teams.

As Senior Product Marketing Manager for the Public Sector, you will own how Chainalysis shows up in the market for these buyers. You will shape our intelligence, data, products, AI capabilities, and services into a differentiated customer story—one that connects to real workflows, urgent problems, and mission outcomes.

This is a role for a strong marketer and an exceptional writer. You can take a complex capability, a shifting market, or a fuzzy customer problem and shape it into a sharp point of view, a persuasive narrative, and practical tools that sellers and customers actually use. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Marketing & Communications, subject-matter experts, and GTM Solutions & Readiness teams to make the story land in the market.

In this role, you’ll:

Position the value

  • Define and evolve the public sector value narrative: what Chainalysis enables, why it matters, and why we are meaningfully different.

  • Build messaging for priority buyer and user personas, from agency leaders to investigators, intelligence analysts, regulators and tax specialists.

  • Create the narratives, proof points, and strategic assets that help sellers communicate differentiated value with conviction.

  • Own public-sector competitive intelligence, translating market moves into clear offensive and defensive positioning for deal teams.

Turn value into solutions

  • Partner with Product, R&D, Marketing & Communications, and subject-matter experts to translate innovation into compelling industry solutions, use cases, and sales plays.

  • Lead go-to-market planning for launches, major releases, platform capabilities, and commercial offerings.

  • Shape customer-facing value narratives for pricing, packaging, and usage-based commercial models, including business cases, operational value and mission impact.

  • Bring a customer lens to product and market decisions: explain not only what a capability does, but how it advances the customer’s mission.

Win and learn in market

  • Partner with Product, Product Marketing, GTM & Enablement teams to scale the strongest narratives into field tools and enablement.

  • Bring customer, field, partner, and competitive insight back into the work — sharpening positioning, converting market evidence into credible stories, and building repeatable use cases.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • 5–8 years in product, solutions, industry, or B2B enterprise technology marketing, with experience marketing to public-sector customers across law enforcement, intelligence, regulatory or tax functions.

  • A demonstrated ability to build positioning and messaging that changes how customers and sellers see a problem—not simply content that fills a library.

  • Experience marketing AI-powered products, data platforms, intelligence products, cybersecurity, or risk and compliance technology.

  • Familiarity with consumption- or usage-based pricing and packaging.

  • Familiarity with investigative, intelligence, national-security, regulatory or tax use cases for intelligence and technology, and the policy developments shaping digital-asset markets.

You can shape complexity into a story people remember and a sales conversation people can use. You write with precision, bring sound judgment to ambiguous problems, build for repeatability rather than one-off requests, and care about the quality of what reaches customers and the field.

In November 2023, CoinDesk was acquired by the Bullish group, owner of Bullish, a regulated, digital assets exchange. For more information on Bullish, please visit https://bullish.com . CoinDesk operates as an independent subsidiary with an editorial committee to protect journalistic independence.

Reports to:

Chief Compliance Officer, US Regulated Entities

Position Overview
We are seeking a BSA/AML Officer with deep Blockchain Compliance expertise to play a key role in the business expansion of our regulated US digital currency trading business. In this role, you will support the spot, derivative, and tokenized securities business lines in the US, encompassing the MTL businesses (spot), FCM, and Broker Dealer entities. As the BSA/AML Officer, you will be responsible for our BSA/AML & OFAC Sanctions programs and ensuring that we maintain compliance with all applicable local, US, and international laws and regulations impacting the digital currency industry. You will also bring specialized knowledge of blockchain structures, networks, and on-chain activities to help our U.S. businesses develop and implement appropriate processes and controls supporting spot trading, derivatives, and tokenized securities activities..

This position is based in NYC and will be required to work from our NYC office. The role reports to the US Chief Compliance Officer.


Responsibilities:


BSA/AML & Sanctions Oversight

  • Lead the compliance program for tokenized securities, derivatives, and spot crypto trading to meet all applicable state and federal regulatory requirements and reflect the nature of a rapidly changing risk landscape, including:
    • BSA/AML compliance;
    • Sanctions compliance;
    • fraud risk;
    • market integrity;
    • Compliance with state licensing requirements;
  • Implement the domestic BSA/AML and OFAC compliance programs in line with U.S. regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain risk-based BSA/AML and OFAC policies and procedures addressing all areas of BSA/AML and OFAC; advise Bullish staff and management of deficiencies and ensure that required changes are made.
  • Direct the domestic BSA/AML and OFAC compliance monitoring program to ensure there are sufficient internal controls to promote an effective control environment.
  • Coordinate with offshore affiliates and exercise oversight to ensure any controls performed on behalf of the U.S. entity by the affiliates are performed to a standard that meets U.S. requirements.
  • Oversee regulatory reporting to FinCEN, SEC, CFTC, FINRA, NFA, NYDFS, and other federal and state regulators, as necessary, to comply with Bullish’s BSA/AML reporting obligations, including ensuring the timely filing of suspicious activity reports (“SARs”).
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting of BSA/AML-related metrics.
  • Identify, escalate, track, and remediate, as necessary, BSA/AML compliance-related issues.
  • Perform BSA/AML, CIP, and OFAC risk assessments as needed and work with stakeholders and various forms of data to inform, update, streamline and optimize the BSA/AML and OFAC program.
  • Lead the process for ensuring all BSA/AML and OFAC reports are filed as required and all BSA/AML and OFAC related records are maintained according to regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to building a compliance culture across the firm by training Bullish employees on key policies, procedures, and their responsibilities in preventing financial crime.

Blockchain Intelligence & Tokenization Compliance

  • Act as the lead compliance investigator and subject-matter specialist for blockchain analytics, wallet clustering, and transaction tracing across spot trading, derivatives margin/settlement, and tokenized assets.
  • Conduct hands-on forensic investigations into flagged deposit and withdrawal addresses using enterprise blockchain tools (e.g., Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic), tracing funds through bridges, decentralized protocols, and mixing services.
  • Play a key role in building Bullish’s U.S. tokenized securities business, working with Legal, Product, and Engineering to develop processes and controls for on-chain trading, custody, settlement, and transfer activities.
  • Apply expertise in blockchain networks, smart contracts, and tokenization structures to design and implement controls that address emerging risks and evolving industry practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and maintain compliance controls for tokenized securities, including wallet whitelisting, investor eligibility verification, transfer restrictions, and on-chain transaction monitoring.
  • Assess proposed token listings, blockchain networks, smart contract upgrades, and bridge mechanisms for financial crime, sanctions, and other compliance risks.

About Unlimit

Unlimit is the global financial infrastructure for the borderless agentic economy. Designed to bridge the gap between fragmented local markets and the future of autonomous commerce, Unlimit provides the programmable operating layer for the world’s most ambitious businesses.

Through an integrated technology stack, the platform unifies global payment acceptance, programmable financial accounts, and digital asset rails into a singular financial layer. By mapping hyper-local payment ecosystems directly into its architecture, Unlimit enables businesses to move value and settle transactions instantly across continents.

Built on decades of hard-won regulatory depth and an extensive global license portfolio, the platform provides direct access to a massive global infrastructure. With major hubs in London, San Francisco, Singapore, São Paulo, and Mexico City, Unlimit is building the infrastructure that makes global expansion a matter of code, not geography.


About The Job
 
As a member of the Unlimit Business Development Team, you will be responsible for driving your own pipeline, seek out opportunities in the market and support the ongoing commercial growth strategy of the organization.

Requirements:

  • 6+ years of total professional experience in business development, sales, or related commercial roles
  • At least 2 years of experience in the online payments / fintech industry, with a broad understanding of the payments ecosystem beyond a single product
  • Proven experience selling pay-ins (card acquiring and APMs) to merchants
  • Strong understanding of one or more target verticals, including market trends, key players, and the competitive landscape
  • Solid knowledge of payment products, processes, and typical client pain points, including card acquiring, alternative payment methods, and end-to-end payment flows
  • Relevant professional network within the payments or fintech ecosystem
  • Proven ability to independently identify, develop, and close new business opportunities, with a strong focus on new business generation and pipeline development
  • Experience managing complex B2B deals with long sales cycles (2+ months)
  • Ability to work with multiple stakeholders on the client side
  • Strong results-driven mindset, with experience working against clear KPIs aligned with market entry and growth objectives
  • Experience in PSPs and fast-paced environments is a strong plus

Responsibilities:

  • Drive strategic new business by identifying, engaging and winning enterprise merchants through a consultative, solution-led sales approach
  • Build and develop a high-quality pipeline of enterprise-level opportunities aligned with Unlimit’s core capabilities across acquiring, APMs and complex payment flows
  • Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise merchants, deeply understanding their business models, payment challenges and global expansion ambitions — positioning tailored solutions that support performance and growth
  • Leverage strong payments expertise to engage senior enterprise stakeholders in meaningful discussions around acceptance strategy, local payment methods, cross-border optimisation and operational scalability
  • Own the full sales cycle for complex, multi-market enterprise deals, from origination through structuring and closing
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Risk, Compliance and Operations to design enterprise-grade, commercially viable and scalable merchant solutions
  • Contribute to Unlimit’s market positioning by acting as a strategic ambassador — building credibility with enterprise merchants and partners
  • Translate market insights into enterprise-focused commercial opportunities, identifying emerging trends in payments and advising on how Unlimit can best support large-scale merchants’ evolving needs
  • Develop long-term strategic relationships with key enterprise merchants and ecosystem partners to drive sustainable growth
  • Ensure a strong understanding of Unlimit’s product suite, operating model and value proposition to effectively position solutions in enterprise-level competitive environments

What We Offer:

  • Competitive monthly salary based on your experience and performance
  • Paid vacation, sick leave, and public holidays
  • Full-time remote role (5/2 schedule, weekends off)
  • Work in an international team with deep expertise in payments and fintech
